literal.description: Re-read one turn of a recorded conversation. Every agent's sessions are listed in the memory index under sessions/ (each document names its conversation id), and the 'where we left off' block at session start shows each turn as one line labeled with its number in square brackets, e.g. [7]. Pass the conversation id and a turn number. The default view, light, shows the user prompts and the agent's replies verbatim and each tool call as one line: its tool, the head of its arguments, the head and tail of its result, the result's size and the call that opens it; it stops at 64 KiB and names the record the turn goes on from. view=prompts shows the user prompts only; view=calls adds every call with its arguments whole and each result as its size; view=full shows the whole turn, a result over 4 KiB as its head and tail. call=<id> opens that call's result and seq=<n> opens the piece holding record n (a search hit or a marker names it) from its beginning: each answers one part of at most 64 KiB, and when more follows a marker names the part=<n> that continues it. Reasoning, attachments and other opaque data are never shown. Use it whenever a log line mentions something you need the details of, and to read the URL, path or id a [link <id>:N] handle stands for.

turn.description: The turn number shown in square brackets in the session's log, e.g. 7 for [7].

conversation.description: The conversation id, as the sessions/ document or the view names it.

call.description: The id of one tool call of that turn, as a light line or a marker names it: opens that call's result, one part of at most 64 KiB at a time.

view.description: light (the default when omitted): prompts and replies verbatim, one line per tool call; prompts: the user prompts only; calls: also every call's arguments whole and each result's size; full: the whole turn, a long result as its head and tail.

seq.description: A record of that turn, as a search hit or a marker names it: opens the piece holding it from its beginning, one part of at most 64 KiB at a time.

part.description: Which part of the piece that call or seq opens, counted from 0 (the default); each part's marker names the next.
